lines.plainText: That every braggart shall be found an ass

lines.text: Rust, sword; cool, blushes; and, Parolles live
lines.plainText: Rust sword cool blushes and Parolles live

lines.text: Safest in shame; being fool'd, by foolery thrive.
lines.plainText: Safest in shame being fool'd by foolery thrive

lines.text: There's place and means for every man alive.
lines.plainText: There's place and means for every man alive

lines.text: I'll after them.
lines.plainText: I'll after them
